title: The lattice n-skeleton ⋃_F latticeFace ρ F is closed
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ and ρ > 0, the union over all face indices F ∈ LatticeFaceIndex n N of the closed lattice faces latticeFace ρ F (the n-skeleton of the cubical decomposition of ℝ^N of side ρ) is a closed subset of ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → IsClosed (⋃ F : LatticeFaceIndex n N, latticeFace ρ F)
